description:
• Added support for playing embedded videos and online media.
• Improved search to easily find results across all albums at once with organized sections.
• Added a quick QR code sharing option to easily share the app with friends.
• General performance improvements, stability enhancements, and navigation updates. • Added MIDI accompaniment support.
• Added background audio playback and improved media controls.
• Improved hymn playback management and stability.
• Added Advent Media Player desktop app integration.
• Added update changelog viewer and download options.
• Added desktop app license registration support.
• Added quick access link to Advent Media Player from the navigation menu.
